description: 从进门点单到买单，把柜台前最常用的十几句话练顺，不用再指着菜单说 this one。

targetChunks.en: Can I get a large iced americano, please?
targetChunks.note: Can I get 是点单万能句，比 I want 礼貌得多。
targetChunks.exampleEn: — What can I get for you? — Can I get a large iced americano, please?
targetChunks.exampleZh: ——您要点什么？——我要一杯大杯冰美式。

targetChunks.note: 在店里喝说 For here。两个词就能回答，不用完整句。
targetChunks.exampleEn: — For here or to go? — To go, please.

targetChunks.en: Could I get that with oat milk?
targetChunks.note: 换配料用 with：with oat milk / with almond milk。
targetChunks.exampleEn: — Could I get that with oat milk? — Sure, no extra charge.
targetChunks.exampleZh: ——可以换成燕麦奶吗？——可以，不加钱。

targetChunks.note: 选择困难时最好用的一句，还能顺便听到店员的地道表达。
targetChunks.exampleEn: — What do you recommend? — The flat white is our best seller.
targetChunks.exampleZh: ——你推荐什么？——馥芮白卖得最好。

targetChunks.note: 跟着朋友点，省事又自然。same 可以指饮料，也可以指套餐。
targetChunks.exampleEn: — I'll have a flat white. — I'll have the same.
targetChunks.exampleZh: ——我要一杯馥芮白。——我要一样的。

targetChunks.en: Could we get two of those?
targetChunks.note: those 指柜台里看得见的东西，配合手指即可。
targetChunks.exampleEn: — Could we get two of those croissants? — Of course.

targetChunks.note: 中文的“少冰”英文就是 less ice，别直译成 little ice。
找座位必问，比 Can I sit here 更地道。
targetChunks.exampleEn: — Excuse me, is this seat taken? — No, go ahead.
targetChunks.exampleZh: ——请问这个位子有人吗？——没有，请坐。

targetChunks.en: Could we get the check, please?
targetChunks.note: 美式说 check，英式说 bill。加 please 更自然。
targetChunks.exampleEn: — Could we get the check, please? — Right away.

targetChunks.en: Sorry, I think there's a mix-up.
targetChunks.note: 上错单、拿错东西时用。比 You're wrong 礼貌很多。
targetChunks.exampleEn: — Sorry, I think there's a mix-up. I ordered an iced latte.
targetChunks.exampleZh: ——不好意思，好像弄错了。我点的是冰拿铁。

targetChunks.note: 店员问 Anything else? 时，一句结束对话。
给小费或懒得等找零时说。递钱同时说，语气自然。
targetChunks.exampleEn: — Here you go, keep the change.

roleplay.promptZh: 你在一家咖啡店点单。要一杯中杯燕麦拿铁、少冰、带走，最后确认价格和取餐方式。
roleplay.promptEn: Order a medium oat latte with less ice, to go. Confirm the price and how you'll get it.
goals: 用 Can I get / Could I get 点单
说清 to go、less ice、with oat milk

script.speaker: staff
script.en: Hi there, what can I get for you?

script.speaker: you
script.en: Hi, can I get a medium latte with oat milk, please?
script.zh: 你好，我要一杯中杯燕麦拿铁。

script.speaker: you
script.en: To go, please. How much is that?

script.speaker: you
script.en: Great, thanks. Could I get a receipt?
script.zh: 好的谢谢，能给我小票吗？
